question: Ano ang mga kailangang sundin sa pwesto at magkano ang babayarang ICAB fee para sa internet cafe o pisonet?
answer:
Sa pwesto sa internet cafe o pisonet, ang mga kailangang sundin sa City Treasurer’s Office ang:

1. ICAB Accreditation fee (Pagbabayad sa ICAB Accreditation) [S1]
   - PHP 100.00 para sa unang 10 units
   - PHP 10.00 para sa bawat unit uliton sa unang 10 units

2. Official Receipt for Internet Café Accreditation Board (ICAB) Accreditation (Receipt ng ICAB Accreditation) [S1]

Maaari ring kailangan ang iba pang mga dokumento na nabanggit sa mga ibang source blocks, kabilang ang:

[S2]
- Notarized Sketch Map of Business Location (Notarized Sketch Map ng Lokasyon ng Negosyo)
- Compliance sa mga ICAB requirements (Compliance sa mga pangangailangan ng ICAB)

[S3]
- Ocular Inspection at ICAB Inspection (Ocular Inspection at Inspeksyon ng ICAB)

[S4]
- Webcams permanently fixed (Webcams na permanenteng nasa lugar)
- No selling and consumption of intoxicating drinks and cigarettes within the premises (Wala sa negosyo ang pagbebenta at pagkain ng alak at sigarilyo)
- Copy of ICAB ordinances (Kopya ng mga ordinansa ng ICAB)
- Headphones (Headphones)
- Urinal for 30 units and below and separate male and female CRs for 31 units and above (Urinal para sa 30 units at kabelow at CRs para sa lalaki at babae para sa 31 units at uliton)

[S5]
- IC Cert. of Authority (IC Cert. ng Authority)

Ang mga ito ay maaaring kailangan sa pagpapatupad ng Internet Cafe Accreditation Board Accreditation. Ang mga detalye ng mga iba pang mga kailangang dokumento ay maaaring nabanggit sa ibang source blocks. Ang ICAB fee ay maaaring bayaran sa City Treasurer’s Office.

ground_truth: The ICAB checklist includes an ISP contract, certification or current receipt of payment; half-closed cubicles not more than 5 feet from the floor apply to Internet Cafes only. Lighting must be at least 25 Lux for fluorescent/LED lights or 50 Lux for incandescent lights. A warning sign at least 12 x 18 inches must state: no pornography, no gambling, no hacking, no minors prior to 6:00 AM and beyond 9:00 PM, and students may not play games during prescribed school hours. A system must block or filter pornographic sites/content; permanently fixed webcams are required for Internet Cafes only. The checklist also prohibits selling and consuming intoxicating drinks and cigarettes on the premises and lists a copy of ICAB ordinances 227-04, 0387-12 and 0270-15, as amended. Headphones, a urinal for 30 units and below, and separate male and female CRs for 31 units and above are listed for Internet Cafes only. For Internet Cafe and Pisonet owners, the fee cell states "PHP100.00 for the first 10 units and PHP10.00 for every unit". This wording is preserved without interpreting "every unit" as "each additional unit".
